frozen: Written and committed before any run, after the governed definitions were committed. Run once; not edited after it has been run. Its first result stands as reported.
held_out: Not used by the learning loop, the curriculum or as recipe examples. The stack is scored on a copy of its saved recipes with learning switched off.
reference: Computed in clinical_core/agere/tiered/proof.py in Python, without the stack's SQL or recipes. Where a plain phrasing has more than one reading, the reference follows the governed definition in catalogue.py, which a buyer would agree in advance.
phrasing: The first phrasing of each question is plain, as a user would ask it; the second states the rule.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong. An unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong. Two phrasings per question, three runs each, three arms, all runs reported.
